usage: webority-cscheck <file.cs|file.cshtml>... [--wait <seconds>] [--timeout <seconds>]
       webority-cscheck --status | --stop | --serve
Checks that the files compile against their project and pass the analyzer rules its build fails on.
Exit 0 clean, 1 errors, 3 checker starting, 4 could not check.
Limits: CSCHECK_MEMORY_MB (default 1200), CSCHECK_IDLE_MINUTES (default 10).
CSCHECK_ANALYZERS=0 turns analyzer rules off; CSCHECK_ANALYZER_BUDGET_MS (default 1500).
